name: Yahweh
overview: The name Yahweh reveals God's eternal and self-existent nature, as He declares Himself 'I AM THAT I AM' to Moses, emphasizing His unchanging presence and authority. This name, distinct from God Almighty, was not fully known to the patriarchs but signifies the personal and covenantal God who is both a warrior and the one true LORD. Scripture affirms Yahweh as the most high over all the earth, deserving of praise and worship, highlighting His unique sovereignty and oneness as the God of Israel.
